name: PC Streaming
requires: DeepPlay Companion on your Windows PC
pitch: Your Windows PC's games and desktop, on your TV.
description: Stream games and your desktop from a Windows PC running DeepPlay Companion. Use the controller as a gamepad, or as a mouse and keyboard with the on-screen keyboard. A USB keyboard and mouse plugged into the PS3 work on the PC as they are.
whatsNew: A USB keyboard and mouse plugged into the PS3 now work on your PC as a real keyboard and mouse, in games and on the desktop. Needs DeepWater 00.77 and the latest DeepPlay Companion; with an older Companion they play as a controller. The Windows key or F1 opens DeepPlay's menu.
